subject: Exec signoff request: Astraforge activation uplift + combined onboarding concession
messages:
From: Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@astraforge.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Miguel Santos <miguel.santos@astraforge.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: onboarding uplift + credits for POC ramp

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency and the model monitoring hooks. We have a pilot running this month but are hitting throughput limits for our more complex prompts. To get a realistic evaluation we need two things: a short extension (2–3 weeks) to the trial window and a modest onboarding credit pool to cover the higher-than-expected token burn during the ramp.

High level ask: 3-week extension to the trial + $50,000 in onboarding credits (applied during the POC), and an upfront pricing adjustment (we're a small startup; 25% off first-quarter invoices if we prepay).

We're on a tight timeline — if we can get executive approval this week we can move to an expanded POC and lock a potential enterprise conversation. Attached are the security questionnaire excerpts they asked about (low risk but want confirmation).

Appreciate any flexibility you can marshal.

Thanks,
Olivia Hart
Head of Product
Astraforge Inc.

Attachment: security-questions.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@astraforge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding uplift + credits for POC ramp

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the questionnaire. I'm looping Ben (AE) to scope the commercial options and will escalate to product/finance for exec signoff.

Quick thoughts (for transparency):
- We can usually support short trial extensions for technical validation.
- $50k is above the typical onboarding credit we offer for a startup POC; need exec approval for anything over $30k.
- The 25% prepay discount is bigger than standard promotional bands; finance will need to assess.

Ben — can you draft two options we can present to Marissa/Finance? Option A = full ask (3 weeks + $50k + 25% prepay). Option B = compromise we can likely get approved quickly (2 weeks + $30k credits + 18–20% prepay discount with a 3-month minimum commitment).

Olivia — I'll push for a quick decision this week. Attached a short proposal draft I intend to circulate to Marissa.

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposal-draft.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Exec signoff request: Astraforge activation uplift + combined onboarding concession

Marissa / David — forwarding the ask from Astraforge. TL;DR: 3-week extension + $50k credits + 25% prepay discount. Customer is early-stage but product-led with clear expansion signals (CTO on the thread).

Recommendation (two packaged proposals to choose from):
Option 1 (Full ask, higher risk): 3-week extension + $50k credits + 25% prepay rebate. Requires Marissa/David signoff and finance to accept the credit exposure.
Option 2 (Recommended compromise): 2-week extension + $30k credits + 18% prepay discount if Astraforge commits to a 3-month minimum spend equal to $12k/month (to be invoiced monthly with prepayment for the first month). This keeps redwood's exposure limited and ties dollars to committed usage.

Financial impact (summary):
- Option 1: immediate $50k credit exposure; potential ARR upside but slower payback.
- Option 2: $30k credit exposure plus near-term cash via a committed minimum; smaller margin impact.

Attached is a quick calc I ran. If we want to fast-track, Option 2 should be approvable by Marissa + David without legal changes — just statement of work + DocuSign. If you want the full ask we should expect a senior-level approval (exec discount band).

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/3981
Attachment: math-breakdown.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

Thanks,
Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@astraforge.com>, Miguel Santos <miguel.santos@astraforge.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exec signoff request: Astraforge activation uplift + combined onboarding concession

Thanks for the clear framing and math, Ben and Soojin. I reviewed the ask and the recommended compromise. Given the expansion signal and product fit, I'm comfortable approving a constrained concession so long as finance gets the upfront protection we need. Approvals as follows (final, please update Docs):

Approved package (conditional):
- Trial extension: 2 weeks (final technical validation window).
- Onboarding credits: $30,000 applied to POC usage (no cash back; credits expire 90 days after activation).
- Prepay discount: 18% off the first invoice if the customer prepays month one at $12,000 (three-month minimum commitment required).
- Requirements: Astraforge must sign the SOW and return the signed DocuSign by EOD Monday (Nov 16). Also require SOC 2 Type II evidence on file before we lift any data-plane access beyond test datasets.

David — please author the invoice template and hold the credits behind the signed SOW. Ben/Soojin — coordinate with Olivia to get the DocuSign to them; update HubSpot and mark the deal next-step as 'POC expansion — credits applied'.

Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

Approved and please proceed.
